items.title: The Marginal Yield of LLM-Guided Alpha Search: Search Effort, Information and Investment Value
items.claim: In this setup, additional LLM factor proposals improve training scores but add no net return distinguishable from zero.

items.title: Expressed distress and portfolio risk in LLM investment advice
items.claim: In this preregistered test, client distress cut LLM allocations above a tolerance-matched volatility reference from 12.2% to 2.8%.
